prompt: GDB AArch64 SME SVG register valid values
answer:
The valid values for the GDB AArch64 SME `SVG` register are:

| `SVG` value | Streaming vector length (`SVL`) |
|---:|---:|
| 2 | 16 bytes |
| 4 | 32 bytes |
| 8 | 64 bytes |
| 16 | 128 bytes |
| 32 | 256 bytes |

Source: [GDB AArch64 documentation](https://sourceware.org/gdb/current/onlinedocs/gdb.html/AArch64.html).
